name: InterzoneXXL
author: L'Cronx
summary: Valley Audio's Interzone synth voice from VCV Rack, played from MIDI in mono or up to 16-voice poly on the module's own panel. Every input jack is patched to a built-in source (LFOs, sequencers, random) on the MPC tempo, with a brickwall limiter and 16 presets.
